entities.name: Embrose Lu
entities.description: A human warlock teacher and master poet, Dean at Silverquill College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios.

entities.name: Dean Shaile
entities.description: An owlin dean with whom Embrose often fought but held a begrudging respect.

entities.name: Killian Lu
entities.description: Embrose's son, who created a sigil that reshaped a duel.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which Embrose defeated compleated faculty.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: One of the few remaining professors in Strixhaven during the Invasion.

entities.name: Invocation of the Founders
entities.description: Something Killian and his friends found after Embrose defeated compleated faculty.

entities.name: Forum of Amity
entities.description: Where Embrose conducted a Naming Tithe ritual.

entities.name: Crownflower
entities.description: A party preparing to settle a dispute through a binding duel.

entities.name: Verdis
entities.description: A party preparing to settle a dispute through a binding duel.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Embrose defeated a host of compleated faculty, letting Killian and friends find the Invocation of the Founders.
events.quote: Embrose Lu defeated a host of compleated faculty members

events.summary: Embrose was summoned to the Forum of Amity to conduct a Naming Tithe ritual amid tensions between Silkmeadow and Tor-Kathorr.
events.quote: Lu was summoned to the Forum of Amity to conduct a Naming Tithe ritual

events.summary: Killian intervened in the Crownflower and Verdis duel by creating his own sigil, reshaping the duel's terms.
events.quote: Killian intervened by creating his own sigil to bear witness
